extension.description: Insert and safely toggle debug console statements across multiple programming languages, manage the processes listening on your local ports, fix the editor checksum warning after patching its core files, and rotate color themes on a schedule.
config.prefix: Prefix included in generated console log messages.
view.ports.name: Port Toolkit
config.ports.refreshInterval: How often the Listening Processes view rescans, in milliseconds, while the view is visible. Set to 0 to refresh only on demand.
config.ports.killTimeout: How long to wait after SIGTERM before escalating to SIGKILL, in milliseconds.
config.ports.hideSystemProcesses: Hide processes that live in system directories or only listen on ports at or below the system port maximum.
config.ports.systemPortMax: Highest port number treated as a system port. A process is only hidden when every port it listens on is at or below this value.
config.ports.includeUdp: Also list UDP endpoints, not just TCP listeners.
config.themes.enabled: Automatically rotate through the color themes listed in `#editorConsoleToolkit.themes.darkThemes#` and `#editorConsoleToolkit.themes.lightThemes#`. Only takes effect while the current color theme is in one of those lists; picking any other theme pauses rotation. Windows whose color theme is set by workspace settings, and Remote windows, are skipped. Has no effect while `#window.autoDetectColorScheme#` is enabled.
config.themes.interval: Minutes between rotations to the next theme of the same kind (dark or light), aligned to the local clock (`60` switches on the hour). Values below `30` turn rotation off (only dark/light switches per `#editorConsoleToolkit.themes.appearance#`); values above `20160` (two weeks) count as two weeks.
config.themes.darkThemes: Dark themes to rotate through, in order, by the name shown in **Preferences: Color Theme** (the value of `#workbench.colorTheme#`). Any installed theme can be listed; themes that are not installed are skipped, and rotation pauses when none of them is installed.
config.themes.lightThemes: Light themes to rotate through, in order, by the name shown in **Preferences: Color Theme** (the value of `#workbench.colorTheme#`). Any installed theme can be listed; themes that are not installed are skipped, and rotation pauses when none of them is installed.
config.themes.appearance: Whether to also switch between dark and light.
config.themes.appearance.schedule: Switch at the times set by `#editorConsoleToolkit.themes.lightTime#` and `#editorConsoleToolkit.themes.darkTime#`.
config.themes.appearance.system: Follow the operating system appearance (macOS, Windows, GNOME-based Linux), checked at each rotation and when settings change. Behaves like `keep` when the appearance cannot be detected.
config.themes.appearance.keep: Keep the current kind; rotate only among themes of the same kind.
config.themes.lightTime: Time (`HH:MM`, 24-hour) to switch to light themes when appearance is `schedule`.
config.themes.darkTime: Time (`HH:MM`, 24-hour) to switch to dark themes when appearance is `schedule`.
